title: How to Make Money from Your Parking Spaces with VOOL
seoTitle: New revenue streams for parking lot owners
description: Make money from your parking spaces thanks to the electric car revolution. How do you turn your lot into a profitable EV hotspot? Find out now!
body:
• If you own a parking lot or parking spaces you can make extra money by installing EV chargers
  • VOOL's solution allows you to set your own charging prices and manage profits using the VOOL App and Admin Portal
  • Attract new customers by transforming parking lots into electric vehicle charging hotspots.
  • VOOL's public charging solution works with any OCPP 1.6 and 2.0 compliant chargers, accepts multiple customer payment options, and will direct deposit monthly profits to your bank account.

Transform your Parking Space into Profit

Europe is embracing the electric transformation, and there's no better time to leverage this opportunity if you want to make money from a parking lot or parking spaces. It’s true, VOOL offers brilliant tech that accesses more of the grid than any charger can, plus the EV charger designs are super chic. But it also just so happens to be a money-making magnet. Install chargers and manage your profits with our easy-to-use VOOL app and web-based Admin Portal.


VOOL works with your parking spaces to do all the heavy lifting, while you manage what to do with your extra revenue. It's time to juice up your parking lot with EV chargers!

The VOOL Setup: A Seamless, No-Nonsense Installation

If you opt for VOOL EV chargers in your parking space, you’ll enjoy our modular design that ensures every parking spot in your lot is ready for charging. Just click the charging module into place, and you're all set. With 4G modules integrated into each charger and a globally usable data package, your chargers will always be connected to the digital world.


If you’re not using a VOOL EV charger (you should) we won’t hold that against you. The VOOL app plays nice with all OCPP 1.6 and 2.0 chargers.

Set the Charging Price: You're in Control

You’re always in charge when you go with VOOL. Choose between a fixed electricity fee or a stock price-based fee. We recommend using our EU-wide automated price detection feature. Because let's face it, you've got better things to do than track energy prices all day.


Once you've selected your electricity contract type, you can set your margins. It’s up to you how much your customers will pay to charge their cars. And you can use the VOOL Portal to get access to a comprehensive overview and easy cost management.

Make your Charger Public: Share the Power

With a few taps, any charger in the VOOL system can be made available for public use. Our public charging feature allows you to share your grid connection and scale from one to hundreds of charging points.

Customers can skip registration with the VOOL app and start charging their EVs by using Apple Pay and Google Pay. Your parking lot instantly turns into an electric car charging hotspot.

Cash In: Keep the Profit Private

We've got you covered with multiple payment solutions for your customers: Stripe, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and credit card.


You'll get paid at the end of the month directly from the portal to your bank account. Kick back and watch your revenue grow.
